tldr: For a randomized treatment contrast in an unconditioned occupation second moment, the note proves the sharp precision frontier from one independently timed state label per individual in the supplied strict progressive Markov model. Its no-log root-MSE sequence is \(r_\beta(n)=\max\{n^{-1/2},n^{-(4\beta+2)/(4\beta+5)}\}\).
